title: Loot Fabricator
description: <keyword>Mob Predictions</keyword> will need to be processed in a <keyword>Loot Fabricator</keyword>, a device which uses <property>power</property> to convert predictions to <property>mob drops</property>. The drops which are available are based on a list of <keyword>pre-defined items</keyword>, and a <positive>target can be selected</positive> for each type of model. The <keyword>Loot Fabricator</keyword> will remember your choices for each type, so you can <positive>feed multiple types of predictions</positive> into a single fabricator.
